caption: The drawing features a wooden rocking horse depicted in profile and positioned centrally on a plain, pale background. The horse is painted primarily white with some brown patches and detailing, such as on its mane, tail, and around the eyes and muzzle. It has black hooves and a brown harness with visible straps. Atop the horse, there is a green saddle with a tan saddle blanket underneath. The horse is mounted on a curved green rocker with decorative yellow accents along the edges, and a rectangular wooden footrest is attached between the rocker’s two curved pieces. The composition is simple with no additional objects or background elements.
title: Rocking Horse
